announcements.headline: Ipsos: Disclosure of trading in own shares under a share buyback programme (9 to 13 november 2026)
announcements.insight: This announcement discloses routine trading activity by the company in its own shares under an existing buyback programme. Such disclosures are standard regulatory housekeeping and do not inherently signal a change in corporate strategy or financial health.

announcements.headline: Ipsos announced that it filed a complaint on Wednesday, 11 November regarding a breach on one of its internal information systems
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates a cybersecurity incident involving an internal system breach. While it raises governance concerns, the lack of detail regarding data exposure or financial impact limits immediate shareholder concern.

announcements.headline: Ipsos appoints Mitch Barns as Chairman and CEO, Americas
announcements.insight: Mitch Barns replaces Kelly Beaver as CEO. This follows Beaver's appointment in July and acceleration of the Horizons plan in September.

announcements.headline: Ipsos: Organic growth of 2.0% in Q3
announcements.insight: This trading update provides a specific metric of organic growth for the third quarter, indicating operational performance but lacking context on absolute revenue or profitability to assess overall financial health.
